//: The domain, in two halves that one test keeps apart (mono-7, narrowed by SPA-174). The pure half: portfolio maths, the two display-format modules, the glossary automaton, the due-date grammar, the view-filter matcher, document extraction and policy, identity normalization, the attribute registry's pure quartet, and (mono-9c) both halves of the web→worker queue seam. The db-coupled half lives under `src/writes/` and nowhere else — the attribute write path lands there (SPA-174), because the plugin SDK's Facts port sits on top of it. `src/purity.test.ts` names the two halves by directory: a `drizzle-orm` import or a value import of @spaces/db fails the build in a pure directory and is allowed under `writes/`; a React import fails it anywhere; a `process.env` read fails it everywhere but `writes/vault/` (MASTER_KEY, DATA_DIR; SPA-176) and `writes/storage/` (STORAGE_DRIVER, S3_*, APP_URL; SPA-178), the two directories allowed to.
name: @spaces/core
//exports: Source entry points, not a build output: every consumer is bundled by vite or loaded by tsx/vitest, all of which resolve TypeScript through `exports`. One subpath per domain, so an `#/lib/<domain>/<module>` import became `@spaces/core/<domain>/<module>` with nothing else changing — `./documents` is spelled twice because the old bare-directory specifier resolved to its index. `./writes/*` is the db-coupled half (SPA-174/175): `#/lib/attributes/<module>` became `@spaces/core/writes/attributes/<module>`, `#/lib/entities/<module>` became `@spaces/core/writes/entities/<module>`, `#/lib/views/store` became `@spaces/core/writes/views/store`, and `#/lib/ai/chunk-sources` became `@spaces/core/writes/ai/chunk-sources`. `./views/target` is the view-target type and key, pure and client-safe, which `writes/views/store.ts` takes its address from. `./context/*` (SPA-179) is the pure half of the context assembler — the ranker, the ref grammar, the renderer, the citation formatter, the tagged errors and the types, snapshots included — and `./read-policy` is `canRead`, the one read predicate; the db-coupled assembler itself (`assemble`, `names`, `similar`, `record`) is still apps/web's, held there by `similar.ts`'s reach into the AI substrate's embedding pin and the search lane's SQL predicate (see SPA-179). `./writes/vault` (SPA-176) is the BYOK vault — `index.ts` over the credential table, with `./writes/vault/key` and `./writes/vault/crypto` beside it — and `./json` is the three jsonb readers (`jsonString`, `jsonRecord`, `jsonValue`) that the vault's write boundary and the app both use; the `Json` type itself stays declared at the columns, in `@spaces/db/json`. `./writes/boot` (SPA-177) is the boot composition — migrate, system attributes, starter taxonomy (`./writes/seeds/taxonomy`), value-index reconcile (`./writes/attributes/reconcile`) — which `apps/web/src/db/boot.ts` wraps in a process. `./writes/storage` (SPA-178) is the blob backend — `storage()` and the `Storage` port — and `./writes/storage/local` is deliberately public too: `LocalStorage`, `blobPath`, `signBlobToken` and `verifyBlobToken` are what apps/web's `/api/blob/$key` route serves a signed download with, so they are part of the surface rather than a route reaching into a package's internals.
//dependencies: unpdf, mammoth and fflate arrived with documents/extract.ts, tldts with entities/normalize.ts, zod with the attribute value validators, pg-boss with queue/sender.ts (mono-9c) — the sender is pure in the sense this package means it, because it is handed its connection string rather than reading one. @spaces/db, drizzle-orm and effect arrived with the db-coupled half (SPA-174): @spaces/db is the one internal dependency spec §2 allows core, and only `src/writes/` may import a value from it — everywhere else the reach stays `import type`, which the purity test enforces. @aws-sdk/client-s3 and @aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner arrived with the s3 driver (SPA-178). Still not here, and the test enforces that too: react, @tanstack/*, and — outside `writes/vault/` and `writes/storage/` — anything that reads the environment.
//devDependencies: dotenv and pg are the test harness's (`vitest.config.ts` loads the workspace `.env.local` through @spaces/db/test-db, and the global setup migrates `spaces_test_core1`), imported by no shipping code.
